'''2011 Canadian National Championship''' was a six-player event.<ref name="t41812">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=41812 2011 Canadian Nationals], forum.starwarsccg.org.</ref> [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] beat [[Alex O'Shea]] in the final.

== Format ==

* '''Winner:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]

== Standings ==

The post gives the Day 2 Worlds byes to Paul Bansal.<ref name="t41812" />
